To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed a novel 2,3,8-triaminoimidazo [1,2-a]-pyrazine structure by the Groebke- Blackburn-Bienayme reaction and its 2-piperoneyl derivative was found to inhibit Hsp90.
a new 2-piperoneyl 3,8-aminoimidazopyrazine was prepared and was found to be a moderate Hsp90 inhibitor, and a complex of the new inhibitor with the Hsp90 N-terminus was also prepared.
a new method was established to synthesize 3,8-disubstituted 2-aminoimidazo [1,2-a]-pyrazines and a novel Hsp90 inhibitor was found.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new synthetic methods for the preparation of 8-amino imidazo[1, 2-a]pyrizines, and their biological activity.
the development of novel Hsp90 inhibitors and the discovery of new MCRs.
the development of new Hsp90 inhibitions through the Groebke- Black-burn-Bienaymé multi-component reactions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the 8-amino-3,8-dihydroimidazo[1.2-a]pyridine scaffold, which was previously found to have moderate inhibitory activity against Hsp90, was further developed into the 8-amido-3,8-diiminoimidazo[2,1-c]pyridine and 8-amino-imidazo[1, 2-a]pyrimidine scaffolds, which were found to have potent inhibitory activity against the ATP

the Groebke- Blackburn- Bienaymé MCR is a powerful tool for the rapid and efficient synthesis of novel 2-alklyl or aryl substituted 8-amino-3,4,5,6,7,9-hexahydroimidazo[1.2-a]pyridine derivatives and their derivatives, and the 2-piperoneyl substituted derivatives have moderate Hsp 90 inhibitory activity.

2-piperone-3,8-diminoimidazo[2,1-c]pyrazines have moderate Hsp 90 inhibitory activity and the activity of 3,8-diaryl substituted 2-piperonal imidazopyrazines is not affected by the substitution pattern of the 3,8-aryl substituent.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the new method and the new structure are both promising in the development of Hsp90 inhibitor.

the new 3,8-disubstituted 2-aminoimidazo-[1,2-a]-pyrazine structures are a new class of Hsp90 inhibitor, and that this new class of HSP90 inhibitors can form a stable complex with N- terminus ATP domain of human Hsp90.
the 2-piperidino and 2-piperanylidene substituents on 8-amino-3-imidazo[1, 2-a]pyridines are important structural features for Hsp90 inhibition.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 3,8-disubstituted imidazo[1,5-a]pyrazin-1-yl scaffold is a promising lead structure for further optimization of Hsp90 inhibitor.
a 2,2,3-trisubstituted 8-aminopyrazine substrate is essential to achieve the high yield and selectivity of this MCR.

the 3-amino-8-phenyl group is the most active group among the 3,8-substituted 2-piperidinoimidazo[2,1-c]pyrazines, and the 8-amino group in 3-phenyl 8-amino-2-piperidinopyrazines is essential to inhibit Hsp90.
